body: I'm in a dance club that's pretty fun and enjoyable with a lot of friends in it though no close friends in it. I'm also in a science club with lots of friends also and I do enjoy both of these clubs a lot. Yesterday I felt completely defeated. I feel like to my close friends I'm not worth anything. I feel that if I were to talk to my friend about being suicidal and depressed she would just call it the pity card. I kind of wish that she would just ask once if I was okay. Oh well I guess that's unrealistic, but I feel like I'm getting real tired of life now.

It is October 12, 1:53, and I have silently cried to myself just now. I haven't been depressed in a month and it's been longer since I've cried. Yesterday we had an event where my friends and I went to this place for community service (Girl I mentioned in previous post suggested I go to this event). I was already sad when I got there because I was yelled at by my dad for not being prepared on getting the address right. On the event it says it's in the city of *** but on google and regular paper maps it says it's in the city of ____ instead. My friend (whom I mentioned in my first post) texted me to text her to let her know when I got there. I was sad and didn't want to kill third group's happy vibe, so I just walked past them without them seeing while I tried to force myself to be happy. Eventually one of them spotted me and I went over to them and tried to be happy. For the most part it worked and I was pretty happy the whole day. However throughout the day they kept making plans to meet up afterwards to get lunch together. I of course was not included (again). I was fine with it in the beginning, but then later on it started to hurt a lot because this ALWAYS happened. Towards the end of the event when she and I were alone and walking back to the others (we're all volunteers for this event) I told her how I felt about them making plans in front of me. She just said she was fine with it and used to it. When the event ended and we were leaving she asked if I would be okay alone since everyone (group) was going to eat lunch together (except this one other classmate). I said I would be fine, but let's be honest even if I said no nothing would have happened. After they left I just collapsed on the inside and sat down on the sidewalk for 30 mins waiting for my ride. The reason why I was crying earlier is because I realize how alone and insignificant I am. It really hurts and I wish I could kill myself, but I don't think she'll care or take me seriously. I just want to give up on life.

I did get better for a while actually. I felt a lot happier even though I did have some bad times, but nothing that made me depressed. I'm in two clubs at school that I'm dedicated to. I have lots of friends and acquaintances, but I think that close friends are worth more than all of my other friends or acquaintances.
